author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Foenix Labs’ A2560Me is a Mini-ITX motherboard built around the Motorola MC68LC060 processor and designed as an updated version of the earlier A2560M platform. The system combines a legacy 68k CPU architecture with FPGA-based subsystems and more recent interfaces such as PCIe and DDR3 memory. title: Foenix Labs A2560Me Brings MC68LC060 CPU, FPGA Graphics, and PCIe Expansion
